title: EEG recordings for semantic decoding of imagined animals and tools during auditory imagery task
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 7 participants performing an auditory imagery task, in which they imagined the sounds made by objects from the semantic categories of animals and tools for 5 seconds. It supports research on semantic decoding and brain-computer interfacing. Recordings were made with a 64-channel BioSemi system, with additional EOG, physiological, and respiration channels.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 electrodes placed according to the 10-20 system, plus earlobe reference electrodes, at a sampling rate of 2048 Hz. EOG electrodes recorded vertical and horizontal eye movements. Wrist electrodes and a respiration belt recorded additional physiological signals. Stimulus images of animals and tools are included.
